task_name: UI SSE client with GET /api/scan fallback

concerns_addressed: Cycle 1's missing coverage for an SSE error after folder frames is now addressed by a dedicated test.
stage_1.assessment: The implementation follows Story 3's incremental-rendering requirement: folder frames update the rendered results, and the done frame renders the final payload. It falls back to GET /api/scan when EventSource is unavailable or errors before folder frames arrive. An error after folder frames closes the stream, clears loading, and avoids a duplicate fetch. Request-ID checks remain in place for rendering, and the completion and fallback paths release loading.

strengths: The four SSE transport tests cover incremental folder rendering and done finalization, EventSource absence, pre-folder error fallback, and post-folder error handling.
The new post-folder error test asserts that fetchCalls is empty, the EventSource is closed, and the refresh button is re-enabled.
The reported full-suite result is 142/142 passing; no tests were run during this read-only review, as instructed.
stage_2.assessment: The previously flagged coverage gap is closed. The new test exercises the hasFolderEvents === true error branch and verifies no duplicate fetch and no permanent loading state. Existing public-test scenarios 1–3 were reported green in the supplied context.
